name: cheap-trick
description: Always-on Codex model router for cost-aware subagent delegation, Spark-aware speed choices, and per-turn model and token estimates.

interface.shortDescription: Route work to the right Codex model
interface.longDescription: Cheap Trick checks every Codex turn, keeps judgement and risky actions on the controller, delegates bounded work to lower-cost models, considers Spark when its speed profile fits, and reports estimated tokens for every model used.
defaultPrompt: Plan this job with the cheapest safe model split
